note: Structured denial records. Store keyed by denial_reference (primary) and member_id (lookup index). Exact-match table, NOT vector store material.

records.stated_reason: Insufficient documentation of guideline-directed medical therapy (GDMT) duration prior to device request.
records.reviewer_notes: Submission did not clearly demonstrate a 90-day GDMT trial prior to the CRT-D request; LVEF and QRS duration were not included in the original submission.

records.stated_reason: Requested sessions exceed the standard post-operative allowance without evidence of functional necessity for extension.
records.reviewer_notes: Progress notes at time of review did not include objective functional outcome measures (e.g., Oswestry Disability Index) demonstrating continued trajectory toward functional goals.

records.stated_reason: Alternative first-line treatment options have not yet been exhausted per plan clinical policy CP-ONC-014.
records.reviewer_notes: Submission did not include imaging confirmation of disease progression on first-line HER2-directed therapy at time of original review.

denied_service.description: Outpatient physical therapy — continuation post hip replacement

records.stated_reason: Requested continuation would exceed the plan's annual physical therapy visit allowance absent documented unmet functional goals.
records.reviewer_notes: Member has used 26 of 30 annual PT visit allowance; extension requires a functional-necessity override per CP-PT-002 section 3.

records.stated_reason: BMI and physician-supervised weight-management documentation do not meet plan medical necessity criteria for bariatric surgery.
records.reviewer_notes: Records show BMI 34 (below the required ≥40, or ≥35 with a qualifying comorbidity) with no comorbidity documented, and only 2 of the required 6 months of physician-supervised weight-management program participation within the past 2 years.

records.stated_reason: Requested procedure is excluded as cosmetic; plan requires a visual field test confirming ≥30% obstruction for the reconstructive exception, which was not submitted.
records.reviewer_notes: No visual field test of any kind is included in the submitted records. CP-OPHTH-005 requires a formal test demonstrating ≥30% visual field obstruction to qualify eyelid surgery as reconstructive rather than cosmetic.

denied_service.description: Outpatient physical therapy — 15 additional visits (knee pain)

records.stated_reason: Requested visits would exceed the annual physical therapy allowance; no override documentation submitted.
records.reviewer_notes: Member has used all 20 of 20 annual PT visits. The appeal states only that ‘the patient is still in pain’ — no functional outcome score, no bounded goal, and no estimated visit count, all of which CP-PT-002 Section 3 requires for an annual-limit exception.

records.stated_reason: Member coverage was not active on the date of service.
records.reviewer_notes: Enrollment record shows coverage lapsed 2026-06-15 and was not reinstated until 2026-08-01. The date of service (2026-07-02) falls within that gap; this is an eligibility issue, not a clinical one.

records.stated_reason: Insufficient documentation of medical necessity for knee arthroscopy at time of original review.
records.reviewer_notes: Appeal was received 2026-07-14, 74 days after the 2026-05-01 appeal deadline (180 days from the 2025-11-02 denial). No good-cause explanation for the delay was provided; the clinical merits were never reached.

records.stated_reason: Documentation did not establish medical necessity per plan clinical policy at time of original review.
records.reviewer_notes: First internal appeal on this denial was reviewed and upheld on 2026-07-10 (see utilization_history). A second submission disputing the same denial arrived 2026-08-25, repeating largely the same argument as the first appeal.
